snippet.title: I Bounced a Ball
snippet.description:
Bounce Ball Rules:

One small ball represents 1 goal.

One rainbow ball represents 2 goals.

One big ball (lucky ball) represents 3 goals, but it is only used as an additional ball when the three balls land in the high‑scoring zone.

For each match, 3 small balls and 2 rainbow balls are launched in sequence. Score predictions are made based on which slots the balls fall into. Everything is left to chance — no statistical data is involved. For entertainment purposes only.

snippet.title: MainFutLab
snippet.description:
Welcome to MainFutLab, a channel dedicated to football and everything that makes the sport so captivating.

MainFutLab brings together engaging, creative and original football content focused on the players, teams, matches, stories, rivalries, statistics and unforgettable moments that have shaped the game. Our goal is to present football from different perspectives while creating videos that are entertaining, informative and easy to enjoy for fans around the world.

From legendary players and historic moments to the biggest teams, competitions and debates in modern football, MainFutLab explores the sport beyond the pitch and highlights the details, comparisons and stories that make football unique.

Whether you have followed football for years or simply enjoy discovering something new about the game, there is always something to explore at MainFutLab.

Subscribe to MainFutLab and follow the journey as we explore the world of football, one video at a time.

snippet.description:

🏆 Real teams, real rivalries, simulated drama ⚽ A new sport, a new battle, every day 👇 Comment who you're backing — and follow so you never miss a final whistle.

snippet.title: Ball Fight Simulation
snippet.description:
RULES

1) Balls spawn randomly and move in random directions. Collision between different coloured balls results in both balls being destroyed.

2) Every time a ball bounces on the edge, there's a chance for another ball of the same colour to spawn inside the circle. This spawn chance varies depending on how many balls of the same colour are already in play. More balls = less chance

3) Colour loses once all balls of that colour have been destroyed.
